{{Recipe}}

This drink is made during Christmas Season. It is very delicious, and your friends will love it.

==Ingredients==

* 4 [[Cookbook:Kilogram|kg]] dark black [[Cookbook:Grape|grapes]]
* 4 [[Cookbook:Liter|L]] water, [[Cookbook:Boiling|boiled]] and cooled
* 4 kg [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Egg White|egg whites]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] (60 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) liquid [[Cookbook:Yeast|yeast]] or 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] (15 ml) dry yeast granules
* 1 handful whole [[Cookbook:Wheat|wheat]]
* ½–¾ cup (120–180 ml) white sugar for colouring

==Procedure==

# Clean and wash grapes well, removing stalks and any debris.
# Crush the grapes until you get a good purple colour. 
# Place the crushed grapes in a ceramic jar, and mix with 2 kg sugar. Mix in the water, egg whites, yeast, and wheat until well-combined.
# Cover with an airtight lid, and let [[Cookbook:Fermentation|ferment]] in a cool place for 21 days, stirring well every other day.
# [[Cookbook:Sieve|Strain]] the mixture and discard the solids.
# Stir the remaining sugar into the liquid, and place back in the fermenting container. Mix well, and keep airtight for another 21 days to ferment.
# Filter the wine using a muslin cloth. 
# Place the sugar for colouring in a heavy bottomed pot over medium heat. Stir until the sugar melts and becomes a dark brown [[Cookbook:Caramel|caramel]]—do not let it burn.
# Remove the caramel from the heat, and gradually and carefully stir in 5–7 Tbsp hot water. Let cool slightly.
# Stir the caramel syrup into the wine, then transfer the wine into a jar for storage.
